description: This Java source file defines the ResponseHelper class, which provides static methods to generate autofill datasets (locked and unlocked) with various presentations for autofill suggestions, including inline suggestions, dropdown, and dialog presentations. It is part of an Android autofill service implementation.

classes.name: ResponseHelper
classes.description: A helper class providing static methods to create autofill datasets with various presentations for Android autofill service.

methods.name: newUnlockedDataset
methods.description: Creates a new autofill dataset with hardcoded values, including inline, dropdown, and dialog presentations, for unlocked autofill suggestions.

methods.name: newLockedDataset
methods.description: Creates a new autofill dataset that requires user authentication, with inline, dropdown, and dialog presentations, for locked autofill suggestions.

methods.name: newDatasetPresentation
methods.description: Creates a RemoteViews object representing a dataset presentation with specified text.
